text: Married Filing Jointly Most people who were married as December 31, 2025 will choose to file jointly with their spouse. The other options are to file separate returns, or, if you qualify, to file as head of household. If you file jointly, you and your spouse report all your income and expenses together on a single federal return, and are jointly responsible for the payment of the tax due. This usually yields a lower overall tax bill than filing separate returns. To qualify for head of household filing status, you'll need to have kids and live apart from your spouse. To explore head of household filing status, click Guide Me.
